name: M'ONDUNIQ Vitamino'MASK intensive rejuvenating face mask with molecular peptides
shortDescription: Professional, intensive face, neck and décolleté mask with molecular peptides, hyaluronic acid, collagen and dragon's blood extract. 200 ml.
description:
A professional, intensive face, neck and décolleté mask whose complex formula supports the skin's hydration, firmness and revitalised appearance.

The formula contains verbena-derived molecular peptides, hyaluronic acid, collagen, vitamins and natural plant extracts. Hyaluronic acid helps retain the skin's moisture, while peptides and collagen contribute to a firmer, smoother skin feel. The "Dragon's Blood" extract in the product complements the formula with its regenerating and revitalising skincare effect.

With regular use, the skin can look more hydrated, smoother and more elastic, while the mask helps reduce the visibility of fine lines and supports a well-groomed, firmer appearance of the facial contours.
